name: IDOT snapshots: YOLO26n boxes
description: Keira's run of Ultralytics' YOLO26n, at a confidence of 0.25 or more, on the snapshots of the three team days: 3,016 boxes, one row each, with the snapshot's name in nanoseconds (timestamps_ns), the class, the confidence, the box in pixels (x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max) and the team day (dataset). A snapshot YOLO26n found nothing in has no row. As committed in keira/yolo26n_detections.csv of isalva2/cities-in-motion-video at commit cf66012d663f. Used with the permission of its authors.
